requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity features, including scan workflow automation and manageability solutions, to simplify business operations for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: Target customers lack dedicated IT staff and require easy-to-use, automated productivity tools to maximize efficiency and ROI.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-powered scan workflow and manageability features are available, functional, and accessible via the SMB portal; user testing confirms ease of use and productivity improvement.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO for SMBs, including minimal intervention and efficient consumable usage.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are highly cost-sensitive and require solutions that minimize ongoing costs and maintenance.
requirements.Dependencies: Keyed bottles, sustainability requirements, efficient ink tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculations demonstrate lowest cost compared to prior HP business models and key competitors in SMB segment; validated by independent testing or cost analysis.

requirements.Title: Sustainable SMB Tank Printer (60% RCP)
requirements.Description: Develop the printer with a sustainability target of at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitors like Epson (30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator for HP and valued by SMB customers; regulatory and corporate responsibility drivers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Prod Steward, Marketing, Quality, Tech Reg
requirements.Dependencies: Material sourcing and supply chain capabilities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material composition reports verify 60%+ RCP in product plastics; sustainability claims validated by third-party certification.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by the customer, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Target SMBs lack IT support; customer-replaceable parts minimize disruption and maintenance expense.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, Service
requirements.Dependencies: Serviceability design, warranty policy, PHA/MINK criteria.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end-users with clear instructions; field tests confirm <15 min replacement time and <5% service calls for related issues.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Consumables
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and reduce user errors.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures correct consumable usage, reduces support calls, and improves user experience for non-technical SMB users.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system design, supply chain for keyed bottles.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All consumable bottles are uniquely keyed; user testing shows <2% error rate in refilling.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Provide a unified portal for SMBs to manage all printers, monitor usage, access AI solutions, and receive support.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs require simple, centralized tools for device management due to lack of IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with AI solutions, device firmware, and support systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, supports multi-device management, integrates AI features, and receives positive feedback in SMB user testing.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' features leveraging AI to optimize output quality and workflow efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP from competitors and addresses SMB need for high-quality, efficient document handling with minimal intervention.
requirements.Dependencies: AI software development, hardware compatibility, SMB portal integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven print/scan features function as specified; quality benchmarks met or exceeded; user testing confirms improved workflow efficiency.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 printed pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require predictable, reliable coverage for budgeting and risk mitigation.
requirements.Dependencies: Service and support planning, warranty terms documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms included in product documentation; service systems configured to track usage and time; customers receive warranty support as specified.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability Thresholds
requirements.Description: Design the product for 'Planned Hardware Architecture' (PHA) customer replaceable parts and 'Minimum Intervention Needed by Knowledgeable' (MINK) at service centers for out-of-warranty repairs, targeting maximum customer replaceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime, improves user experience, and lowers service costs for SMBs without IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware design, service documentation, training materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service documentation specifies PHA and MINK parts; >80% of common repairs are customer-replaceable; field data shows reduced service center visits.

requirements.Title: PDL and Non-PDL SKU Differentiation
requirements.Description: Release both PDL (Page Description Language) and Non-PDL SKUs, with PDL supporting higher print speeds (target 25/20 ppm), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification; Non-PDL supports SMB 2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses varied SMB needs and regulatory requirements, enables market segmentation and compliance.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, Tech Reg, R&D Telemetry, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware/software development, certification processes, SKU management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs available with specified features; print speed and certification targets met; portal and PaaS support functional.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for SMB users.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern workstyles and increases convenience for SMBs with mobile-centric workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing works reliably with HP App; user testing confirms <2 min setup and successful print from mobile devices.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Platform as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer and associated software support PaaS business models, enabling solutions monetization and service delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP’s strategic intent to accelerate PaaS and opens new revenue streams.
requirements.Dependencies: Software platform integration, licensing, and billing systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer integrates with PaaS platform; SMBs can subscribe to and utilize services via portal.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Achieve Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKU to meet regulatory and customer sustainability expectations.
requirements.Rationale: Satisfies regulatory and market requirements in key regions; supports HP’s sustainability positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU passes Blue Angel certification and is listed in relevant registries.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry capabilities for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and usage tracking to support SMB manageability and service.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, reduces downtime, and provides data for continuous improvement.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware, portal integration, data privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely collected, accessible to support teams, and actionable insights are generated; privacy compliance validated.
